balls.text: a slower ball down leg side, fine leg is in the circle and Bhatia knows that, he waits and paddles it past the fielder, finishing the innings with a boundary
a slower full toss and Lee mis-hits it towards the leg side
Lee's got a full toss and he's smashed it, getting under the ball and lofting over long-on

Zaheer's taken a superbly judged catch! Shukla slogged at a short of  length ball, top-edging it high on the leg side, I think Zaheer had to run from mid-on to his right and catch the ball around the wide mid-on region
good length outside off, hit hard but to cover
slower ball outside off stump, the batsman backed away towards leg and was too far away to play a shot
backs away and pulls and slower ball towards deep midwicket, the throw from the fielder to the keeper is a shocker and the batsmen run an overthrow
a slower short ball this time, Shukla backed away and tried to blast over point, he was beaten by the change of pace
Shukla tries to pull but once again is beaten by the extra bounce just outside off stump
Shakib's teed off, but he hasn't hit it very far. Pujara settles under the ball at long-off and takes the catch. Shakib wanted to hit that over extra cover but connected with the toe of his bat
short ball and Shukla pulls with power, but to the fielder on the square leg boundary
Shukla tries to cut but gets beaten by some extra bounce outside off stump, Vinay has been superb today
Shakib goes right back and pulls the ball toward deep square leg
width outside off stump, Shukla goes back and cuts through point
slower and straighter, Shakib goes back and plays towards long on
another wide ball down leg side
a flat ball fired down leg side
sweeps towards deep backward square leg
caught at short fine leg! The slide continues. ten Doeschate tries to sweep but top-edges the top-spinner to Vettori, an easy catch. Will Kolkata even get 160 now?
tossed up from round the wicket, driven to long on but not timed well
a full ball angling into the right-hander, ten Doeschate drives to long-on and wants two. Shakib gets home before Zaheer breaks the stumps

caught at deep square leg! The slower ball does Tiwary in, he was through his swat on the leg side too early and ended up hitting it in the air to Mayank Agarwal on the square leg boundary, Kolkata are falling apart at the finish
defended from the crease on the off side
good length and straight, played back to the bowler

caught at short third man, off the reverse swat and off the back of the bat. Gambhir tried to use the uneven side of the bat to hit the ball past short third man but failed, the ball went straight to the fielder. He basically tried to reverse paddle but with the back of the bat
that's not that short but Gambhir is waiting on the back foot, rocking back and pulling with power to the square leg boundary
wide ball outside off stump, Gambhir hits it from his crease to point
Tiwary pulls a ball that is not that short towards square leg
hit hard of fthe back foot towards cover point

short of a length with width outside off, Gambhir stays in his crease and flat-bats it past the bowler, he hit it with immense power. It's Kaif on the boundary, though, and he's still an exceptional fielder. He runs to his left and dives to save the four
Gambhir steps out of his crease and Harshal meets him with a bouncer, Gambhir tries to hook but misses
Gambhir stays in his crease and cuts the ball through point, he sprinted back for the second
good length and straight, Tiwary defends on the off side
good length ball around off, dabbed from the crease to point, Gambhir wants one but gets sent back
another short ball, Gambhir pulls towards deep square leg. Tiwary's throw wasn't a good one but they don't run an overthrow
a sharp short ball, it climbs on Gambhir, who tried to jump up and fend it down on the off side. He might have smelled leather as the ball whizzed past his face
steered from the crease towards third man

caught at point! You rarely see Gayle in that position but he's taken at easy catch. Yusuf tried to blast a short of a length ball from outside off stump down the ground, he ended up slicing it at chest height to the catcher. That one bounced a bit more on Yusuf
Gambhir goes back and cuts towards point
played off the back foot on the leg side
appeal for a catch at slip first ball! The umpire says not out. Yusuf tried to sweep and the ball lobbed off the top part of the glove to Gayle at slip, Yusuf's lucky to get away with that one

stumped! Bisla charged Murali again, this time he was beaten by the flight and beaten by the straighter one. AB fumbled the take a little but Bisla was so far down that he completed an easy stumping in the end. Bisla, however, has done his job.
Gambhir slog sweeps the ball through square leg
Bisla comes out of his crease to Murali and flicks off the pads towards deep square
Gambhir's ruined Vinay's economical over by waiting in his crease and launching a length ball flat over extra cover. Top shot to bring up his fifty. The ball fell just short of the boundary
short of a length delivery, Bisla stays in his crease and heaves towards long-on, the ball reaches the fielder on the first bounce
a slower ball on a fullish length angling into Gambhir, the ball kicks off the surface but Gambhir is ready with the deft dab to third man
Gambhir has a huge heave at a good length ball outside off, he gets beaten
Bisla charges and tries to hit through the off side, he has to dig the ball out of the blockhole in the end
slower ball. Gambhir spots it, waits and dabs to third man. Over to Bisla.

Bisla charges, he heaves, he mis-times it. The ball lobs in the air but falls safely just outside the circle at midwicket. Vettori couldn't reach it from the infield. It's all very manic out there at the moment.
Bisla was aiming midwicket but got long leg, the ball thudded off the inside edge as he tried to drive
short of a length outside of stump from round the wicket, Gambhir waits and cuts to third man
shorter ball and it skids on, Bisla swivels and pulls behind square
he's teed off with tremendous impact! Bisla steps out of his crease and deposits a length ball into the stands behind the midwicket boundary with a mighty swing
short of a length ball outside off stump, Bisla swings mightily, trying to pull over midwicket, but makes no contact
another powerful drive but the fielder in the deep at cover prevents the boundary
drilled down the ground but Pujara at long-on makes a diving save
played on the off side

he's been beaten by the flight but it doesn't matter! Bisla charged Vettori, who dropped the ball slightly short and held the pace back. It sat up for Bisla, who swung hard and hit through the line, clearing the long-on boundary
Gambhir steps out and drives the ball through midwicket
Bisla tries to hit down the ground but mis-times it towards midwicket, Vettori runs after the ball
Bisla pushes forward to defend but gets an outside edge past first slip
short ball and Gambhir goes back to pull towards deep square leg
Bisla tries to reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pad, the impact was outside the line of off stump
swept to short fine leg for a quick single
that is remarkably deft, Gambhir moves back, waits for the ball to angle into him, and then dabs it so late, beating Gayle at slip
round the wicket to the left-hander, he hits the pads after Gambhir tries to go back and play towards square
played back to the bowler from the crease
shot! Bisla charges, moves towards leg to create hitting room, and lofts the ball inside out with a full swing of the bat, finding the gap on the cover boundary
Bisla comes down the track again, Vettori sees him and bowls it flatter, faster and shorter, Bisla whips off his pads towards long leg
tight line and length, played back to the bowler
dug out on the off side for a single
Bisla makes room by moving forward and towards leg and drills the ball through cover, giving Mayank some work to do in the deep
played from the crease towards midwicket
Bisla backs away towards leg and then reaches out to squirt the ball through point, he gets more of an outside edge that goes between the keeper and short third man, he's getting a move on
played from the crease behind point
pushed off the front foot to cover
a bit of an outside edge towards Zaheer at short third man
how has that carried over long off? It looked like Bisla had plonked his front foot forward and slogged it in the air. He evidently made clean contact, hitting through the line
clipped off the pads through square leg
Gambhir leans forward and dabs towards point
charges again and lofts the ball towards long off
he charges immediately but isn't close to the pitch of the ball, ends up awkwardly defending with his pad

caught behind! Vettori pitched on a good length in line with the stumps but did not spin it away, the ball went on with the angle of the arm. Kallis moved back to cut from in front of the stumps and got a thick edge into AB's waiting gloves
drifts into the right-hander from round the wicket and beats the bat by spinning away
they are taking the fight to Murali. Gambhir charges, moves towards the leg side and lofts the ball flat over extra cover. Expensive start for the bowler who was crucial in Bangalore beating Delhi
Kallis moves back and across to nudge off the pads behind square
dabbed off the pads towards midwicket
Gambhir charges Murali and hits towards mid-on
played off the pads towards midwicket
and Kallis gives him a hostile reception, getting down on one knee, leaning towards the off side, and hammering the slog sweep to the backward square leg boundary, that's flat and carried all the way
Zaheer angles the ball into the right-hander from round the wicket, Kallis waits and dabs to third man
Gambhir stays in his crease and squirts the ball towards third man
Kallis tries to drive from the crease but gets an outside edge towards third man, the pace was a bit slower and the line was around off stump
this time he tries to close the face to play on the leg side but gets a leading edge of sorts past the bowler, Kallis slips as he goes for the run
overcompensates by straying on to the pads, Gambhir moves towards the off side and clips it to the backward square leg boundary
he's launched it! Gambhir gets on to the front foot and drives the ball flat and hard over extra cover. The length was extremely driveable outside off stump
Kallis jumps down the track and tries to blast a short of a length ball through cover, he gets beaten by the extra bounce, he was cramped for room as well
steered from the crease towards third man

immense! Gambhir walks down the pitch, converts the length into a full one, moves slightly towards the off side to get inside the line of the ball, and then hoists it off his pads over the square leg boundary
short and wide outside off, Gambhir pounces, cutting the ball late and deftly through the gap at backward point
Gambhir tries to hit a full ball too hard and mis-times towards the bowler
short ball and Gambhir swivels and pulls, finding the square leg boundary, there's been a glut of them in the last few minutes
played towards the leg side

in the air but it's just short of the fielder diving forward at mid-off! Kallis came forward and tried to drive through the line once again, this time the length wasn't as full and the ball bounced a bit more, hitting high on the bat. Vinay lunged forward at mid-off but couldn't get under the ball as it travelled flat towards him
Kallis lets it go outside off stump, the length was better, and the line was closer to the body
this time the length is driveable and there's width outside off stump, Kallis strides forward and drives through the line, placing the ball wide of the fielder at mid-off
good shot selection from Kallis, this ball is good length and angling across the right-hander, there's more bounce than usual and Kallis shoulders arms
a half-volley on the pads and Kallis has blitzed it, flicking with power and beating the man on the backward square leg boundary
there he goes! Gambhir charges Vinay, and then carves a length ball over the infield at cover and to the boundary, he slashed hard at the ball
short of a length with width outside off, Gambhir cuts hard from his crease but can't beat point
too straight from Vinay, Kallis whips the ball fine off his pads, this time Harshal Patel sprints to his right at fine leg and dives to pull off the save
bouncer, Kallis tries to hook but misses, this surface has some pace and bounce
good length outside off, defended from the crease on the off side
Gambhir stays in his crease and dabs his first ball between first slip and gully to third man
good length outside off stump. Had the previous ball been a good one, Kallis might have felt compelled to play this, now he doesn't, and lets it go
ah, bad ball, too straight and Kallis easily whips it off his pads to the fine leg boundary
top over so far, Kallis once again gets beaten by one that seams away from him
Kallis chases a good length ball, trying to cover drive as it seams across him, and is beaten

this one angles across Kallis, who tries to steer through point and is beaten, that bounced through nicely to the keeper. So the second ball moved away from the right-hander, the first one had come in
pitches on a good length and straightens back into the right-hander after angling across him, Kallis defends on the leg side
second wicket for Shakib to finish the game, Vinay charged out for the loft over long on, but found Shukla there, fine catch taken just inside the rope
belted down to long on
reverse-lapped to short third man
tries to pull, but it loops in the air off the top-edge and falls in front of deep midwicket
another heave down to deep midwicket
swung down to long on
heaved wide of long on for a tight couple
full ball pushed away to deep midwicket
mishit to deep midwicket this time
that has gone through Tiwary at deep midwicket, the shortish ball was smacked hard by Zaheer, Tiwary had it covered to his right but it just whizzed through his hands
guided down to third man
way too far wide outside off stump, Bisla cannot collect cleanly
Shakib has a wicket, he angled it in from a good length, Patel ended up playing outside the line as he looked to run it towards third man, Shakib was on target as he found off and middle
a push wide of cover for a single
fires it in full, pushed back towards the bowler, they go for the single, Shakib runs towards the ball, dives forward and lobs it to the keeper, but non-striker has made it
full, flighted and wide outside off
gets down on a knee and swings, gets it over cover for a couple
dabs a length ball to point
he went for the yorker, but could not get it in the blockhole, Vinay was making room again, and this time connected well enough to send it soaring over the straight boundary
sees him back away again and keeps it full close to off stump, Vinay misses
gets front leg out of the way, Lee goes well outside off, Vinay reaches out and mistimes the hit
makes more room outside leg, this time Lee follows him with a back of a length ball, he somehow manages to swing it wide of Balaji at fine leg, Balaji does well to stop the boundary with a slide
backs away and has a heave at a pitched up ball, mishits it to midwicket
beats him as he wafts at a shortish one taking off some way outside off
missed stumping, down the track, the flighted ball dips and beats him, keeper misses the take as well, Vinay would have been easily stumped otherwise
goes back and punches to deep midwicket
comes down the track and swings down to long on
pushed off the front foot on the off side for one
another wide with the angle down leg
uses the angle into him to whip it past short fine leg
fired in wide down the leg side from a length
tucked off the pad behind square leg
lifted in the air down to long on
reaches out a and guides a very wide delivery wide of point
goes deep in his crease and blocks a short of a length ball
Tiwary has picked out the man in the deep again with an awkward pull, and this time he is not getting away with it, Shukla it is at deep midwicket who takes the catch, another one goes down
slants it across the left-hander, wide outside off
awkwardly pulls a shortish one through midwicket
another low full toss hit down to long on
cannot get a slow fullish ball away, Bhatia fields on the off side
low full toss bashed straight down the ground, long off in action again
slog-swept behind square leg for a four from around middle and leg
wristily whipped in the air down to long on
full ball drilled down the ground, long off gets around
lofted down to long off
another pull, deep midwicket is in place, so are long on and deep square leg, the boundary is well defended on the on side
hit along the ground to deep midwicket off the pad
pushed towards extra cover
that would have been wide in any format, way, way outside off
adjusts and pulls a slow length ball to deep midwicket
pulled square for one
rides the bounce on a short of a length ball and gets it to third man

Balaji has four, there is no getting away from him today, Vettori has been moving around in the crease all the time, misses as looks to swing fine down leg from outside off stump, and Balaji is on target with a slow length delivery, which bounces and crashes into the top of off stump
appeal, there was a noise as the ball passed the batsman, it clipped the top of the pad on its way to Bisla, could have pitched outside leg, caught him high as well
in the blockhole around leg stump, and that is why he cannot push it anywhere beyond mid off even as he backs away outside leg
makes even more room by shuffling outside off stump, this time the ball sails over middle as Vettori misses again, Bisla cannot stop the ball on the bounce
got outside the line of a shortish one just outside leg stump, tried to help it fine but missed, earns a wide call
now he goes a mile outside leg stump, but cannot beat point
pulled back just inside the deep point rope, Tiwary could have gone though, he threw his bat at this pitched up ball, and sliced it just wide of a diving point fielder
swung off an inside edge to short fine
he was about two feet outside off stump as he played this shot, bends the knee and paddles it fine on the leg side
Vettori gets one away, and gives the crowd something to shout about, gets front leg out of the way and connects with the slog-sweep, over deep midwicket
tries to dab it fine but gets it to backward point
lofted down to long on, one bounce to the man

dropped by Shakib at deep square leg, it was as straightforward a take as possible, Tiwary had come charging out and swung in the air, picking out Shakib in the deep, but it popped out of his hands in the first attempt, he tried to take the rebound, even that popped out, there was to be no third chance
now he flows into a drive to a fullish bal angled wide across him, down to long off
he gets outside off stump again and this time connects, helps it to the fine leg boundary, typical Vettori

almost another one, Vettori walked way outside off stump looking for his preferred region behind square leg, missed, the ball which rolled onto the off side, Tiwary had completed half the run before he turned back, the throw missed anyway
Vettori is away with a boundary wide of third man, uses the angle and width on this length ball to dab it, got the timing just right
poor stroke from Agarwal, but Balaji is unstoppable tonight, Agarwal walks down the track but only ends up spooning a length ball to extra cover for a simple catch
slower one bowled with a legbreak action, fullish on middle and leg, worked on the on side
full one worked off the pads through square leg, the man in the deep runs in hard and keeps them to one
very slow from Bhatia, batsman has to make all the effort, he goes back and punches it past extra cover
tries to break free, goes hard at this pitched up ball, on the bounce to Lee at long off
an orthodox forward defensive push from Tiwary won't earn him the single, he has to get back in time as the keeper gets to the ball on the off side
inside-edges the big drive on to pad, they get the single as the ball rolls to point
a leave off the last ball of the eighth over outside off has the asking-rate going up to 11.50
gets bat in front of pad in time to tuck this length ball through square leg
dabbed down to third man with the angle for one
short of a length and climbing in to the body, tucked behind square leg

what a delivery! even some one of the class of AB de Villiers has no answer to this beauty from Balaji, angled in on a good length, straightens appreciably and skids off the pitch to hurry on past the defensive push and strike off stump, AB was playing that one from the crease and had no chance of countering the movement
driven wide of sweeper cover for a couple
more slow stuff from Bhatia, AB has to adjust and manages to tuck it square on the leg side
slower one loops in on to the pads, turned square for a single
right on the middle stump from a good length, he gets across and blocks
pulls a shortish one down to deep midwicket
slow delivery arrives second ball from Bhatia, AB pats it back to the bowler
loopy widish full delivery, AB could have dispatched that, he drives it to extra cover instead
carries across the left-hander with the angle, left alone

Balaji has struck, anther massive wicket for KKR, and the celebration says it all, they are all over Balaji, Virat's instinct was to turn this length ball square on the leg side with the angle, he ended up closing the face too early, and the leading edge carried to point, they check for the no-ball but Balaji looks to be alright
and now this one goes through Virat, that one came back in a long way, was angled in as well, Virat was pushing way outside the line in the end, neat take by Bisla
this one carries in with the angle, Virat tucks it away, but straight to midwicket this time
again it holds its line after pitching back of a length, Virat was looking to whip it through midwicket but ended up finding mid on
charges out right away, but Balaji gets it to hold its line after angling it in, and Virat is beaten once again
whips a shortish one towards square leg for a single
tries to guide it through point on the up, but there is too much bounce on this one from Lee, from a good length too, and Virat is beaten
plays out a length delivery with an open face to point
softly dropped on to the off side for one
tries to repeat the stroke but is beaten by the bounce

outrageous from the South Africa captain, that has sped past backward point, not far away from him, but he hardly took a step to his right, and the ball was already gone, it wasn't even that wide from Lee, AB hung back in his crease, and made some room for the cut, and boy, did he time it
too wide, and Virat is in the form of his life these days, he waits on it and dismisses it past extra cover, no fuss at all
has AB going deep in his crease with a sharp shortish one, dropped in front of point for one
whips a back of a length ball wide of midwicket

this was on the cards, he was either going to blast off or get out, the latter has happened, Gayle  tried to pull a short delivery over midwicket, but the top edge only settled safely into mid-on's hands, massive wicket, the length, the length has been the key, and Kallis had the pace to hurry Gayle from that length
this is unusual for Gayle, he tries to take the single with a work behind square, but Lee denies him with sharp work
Gayle is being kept quiet, for the moment, Kallis digs in a sharp bouncer across him, Gayle ducks
and now this one moves away sharply, from that same back of a length, Virat winds up and throws his bat at it, cannot connect

this shortish length is working for Lee at the moment, this one also nipped back in a long way from just outside off, Virat had no chance of dealing with it, unfortunately for Lee, that missed the inside edge, and also off stump
slowish from short of a length, Gayle cannot get under these lengths, opens the face and takes the single to third man
even better, this time he gets it to bounce from back of a length, Gayle hangs his bat out at it, and is beaten
good delivery, right on the stumps, pitches full, Gayle opens up, gets the bat down in time and runs it to point
angled across the left-hander, close to off, he has a look and lets it go past
Kallis is bowling at brisk pace today. Kohli lets a short of a length ball go
short of a length around off, played off the back foot to point

edged and caught at slip! KKR are pumped as a hush falls over the Chinnaswamy. Pujara tried to steer the ball towards third man and opened the face to do so, the ball angled into him and bounced a bit more, taking the edge to Yusuf. Pujara was moving forward to play the ball and wasn't balanced
good length slanting into the right-hander from over the wicket, Pujara stays in his crease and opens the face to play towards point
played off the back foot towards the off side
good length first up, Gayle stays in his crease and clips the ball from middle towards midwicket
there's width outside off stump, Pujara square drives off the back foot but to the fielder
played from the crease towards point
Lee appeals for lbw but there was a thick inside edge on to the pad

shot! It's a short ball outside off stump, Pujara stays well balanced in his crease and chips it over the slip cordon and into the Kolkara dug out. Pujara just let the ball bounce off the bat, using it like a ramp
this time the ball angles in and hits the inside edge as Pujara moves slightly forward to defend
Lee pitches on a good length around off and seams the ball sharply away from Pujara, who stayed in his crease and prodded, the ball beat the outside edge by a huge margin
